name: yanif-client
description: React frontend for Yanif card game platform

scripts.test:e2e: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit || exit 1 && npx playwright test api-game-flow --project=chromium --workers=1 --reporter=line && npx playwright test full-game-flow --project=chromium --workers=1 --reporter=line && npx playwright test websocket-game --project=chromium --workers=1 --reporter=line
scripts.test:e2e:headed: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit || exit 1 && npx playwright test full-game-flow --project=chromium --workers=1 --reporter=line --headed && npx playwright test websocket-game --project=chromium --workers=1 --reporter=line --headed
